facts.fact: Mia 与 Aiden 把婚期定在 Beltane（五月初），理由是希望 Sylvie 在还能行动时参加。
facts.anchor: we want Sylvie to be as fit as possible to celebrate with us

facts.fact: Amrita 对 Jamie 承认自己的工作同样被繁文缛节消耗，但病人肯努力时一切都值得。
facts.anchor: a lot of the red-tape frustration in my job too

facts.fact: Jamie 说出 Ophelia 是女巫时，魔法自动抹掉 Amrita 的记忆，他亲眼看见「魔法保护自己」的城规生效。
facts.anchor: Of course, he knew Hudsbury’s lore – that magic was a secret that protected itself from outsiders

facts.fact: Jamie 带 Amrita 进 Glimmers and Sparkles 的储藏厨房，店里已提前布置成情人节的样子。
facts.anchor: into a world where Valentine’s Day had arrived – and exploded – early

facts.fact: Amrita 讲旁遮普家里做饭的规矩：在场的人都要帮手，一起做饭是把家人揉合在一起的方式。
facts.anchor: Cooking with the people you care about is part of being a family.

facts.fact: 她做 dhungar 时往锡纸杯里放烧红的木炭，浇上黄油，烟雾旋成一个心形。
facts.anchor: forming the shape of a heart

facts.fact: 厨房里两人靠近时，Amrita 用「新朋友」给这段关系定性。
送她上车前，Amrita 在他脸颊上快速吻了一下，气味让她觉得熟悉而安全。
facts.anchor: She leaned close and placed a quick kiss on his cheek
